preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 200.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of integers N is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 10**18 for k in Ks)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the non-negative integer k is between 0 and 10^18.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**18 for A in As for i in range(len(A)))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array A is a non-negative integer between 0 and 10^18.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], int) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output contains an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= output[i] <= (Ns[i] * (Ns[i] - 1)) // 2 for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer and does not exceed the maximum possible number of pairs (N choose 2).
